data.name: Nisaa
data.long_meaning: Nisaa is an Arabic name for four women. It is derived from the Arabic word ‘nisaa’ which means ‘four women’. It is a name that symbolizes strength, unity, and femininity. In Islamic tradition, the Four Caliphs are considered the rightful successors of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), and Nisaa is a fitting name for a girl born into a family with strong Islamic values.

in_english.name: Nisaa

The name symbolizes the importance and spiritual value of women in Muslim culture and society. Historically, it reflects the respect and reverence for women in Islam.
